primaryText: Jim is at home right now.
context: A non-modal assertion in the control vignette; participants rated on a 7-point scale either whether what the speaker said is false or whether they would respond 'No, ...'.

Smith, one of the experts who examined the planted evidence of Fat Tony's murder, asserts the epistemic might-claim; participants, told they are also on the case and know that Fat Tony faked his death, rated on a 7-point scale either whether what Smith said is false or whether they would respond 'No, Fat Tony is alive. He faked his death.'
